working_definition: A Turble is a high-surface, high-energy, high-imitation, uncertain-depth memetic persona or creature whose identity is formed through expressive cues, social participation, imitation, projection and turbulent circulation. Turbles transmit culture quickly because they are readable and reproducible; they generate when imitation opens toward understanding and degenerate when surface replaces depth.

canonical_morphology.eyes: two very large round eyes with large pupils
canonical_morphology.limbs: two short arms; thin short legs
canonical_morphology.wings: optional; some have small angel-like wings

etymological_cloud.turtle: ancestral I-like-turtles association and non-sequitur innocence
etymological_cloud.terrible: comic incompetence, degeneration and deliberately bad coinage
etymological_cloud.turbulent: irregular mixing, mutation, recirculation and unstable memetic flow

primary_axes.surface_intensity: how much identity is communicated through visible expression, symbol, costume and role
primary_axes.mimetic_appetite: how readily encountered forms are copied and repeated
primary_axes.social_velocity: how quickly encounter becomes reaction, participation or reuse
primary_axes.comprehension_gap: distance between what can be reproduced and what can be explained
primary_axes.turble_gap: distance between intended persona and perceived persona
primary_axes.turbulence: degree of mutation, remix, collision, branching and unstable recirculation
primary_axes.individuation: degree of differentiation through history, knowledge, responsibility, skill and particular identity
primary_axes.generativity: capacity to turn participation into understanding, skill, work, relationship or future capability
primary_axes.degeneration_risk: risk that visible form intensifies while reason, context and competence decay

developmental_law.generation: surface -> imitation -> curiosity -> practice -> understanding -> cultivation -> individuation
developmental_law.degeneration: surface -> imitation -> repeated imitation -> exaggeration -> detachment from reason -> hollow form
developmental_law.summary: When surface opens toward depth, the Turble generates. When surface substitutes for depth, the Turble degenerates.

perception_model.metaphor: At first we see each other through mud and broken glass.
perception_model.mud: obscurity, missing context, unfinished and impressionable material
perception_model.broken_glass: real but fragmented evidence arriving in shards
perception_model.turbulence: circulation that changes which fragments are salient and how they are interpreted
perception_model.result: a readable low-resolution social model that may mix truth, caricature, performance, projection and missing context

cultural_loop: person -> expression -> mask -> Turble -> interaction -> imitation -> herd -> culture -> myth -> person

archetypal_ingredients.dog: relational eagerness, social attention, pack sensitivity and action-before-complete-understanding
archetypal_ingredients.troll: unstable sincerity, provocation and post-ironic ambiguity
archetypal_ingredients.minion: small-worker population logic, costumes, service and herd-scale comedy
archetypal_ingredients.furby: projected interiority, responsiveness and uncertainty about comprehension
archetypal_ingredients.furry_avatar: identity through chosen creature embodiment and customizable persona
archetypal_ingredients.devotional_follower: devotion can precede comprehension; imitation can become either practice or empty ritual

potato_relation.summary: The Turble is not simply a failed Potato; it is a model of imitative becoming.

sage_relation.sage: concentrates and differentiates meaning; generates depth
sage_relation.turble: compresses and circulates meaning; generates diffusion
sage_relation.ecology: healthy cultural transmission can require both depth and diffusion

footstool_transition.name: Turblification
footstool_transition.sequence: mud / footstool -> mimetic orientation -> visible potato-expression -> repeated performance -> recognizable Turble identity
footstool_transition.boundary: A real person is not permanently classified by this metaphor; Turble describes a bounded mode of presentation or participation.

project_terms.surface_intelligence: sensitivity to mood, status, signals, humor, attention and group movement despite uneven abstraction
project_terms.expressive_surplus: emotional display larger and more legible than circumstances strictly require
project_terms.turble_cascade: gesture -> imitation -> repetition -> norm -> institution -> mythology
project_terms.turble_gap: distance between presented persona and perceived persona
project_terms.turblification: transition into persistent Turble expression through imitation and recognizable surface identity
project_terms.memetic_turbulence: irregular circulation in which signals are copied, exaggerated, misunderstood, remixed, archived and rediscovered

compact_formulas: Turble = high surface + high energy + high imitation + turbulence + uncertain depth + possibility.
The Turble is surface becoming culture.
Sages generate depth; Turbles generate diffusion.
The Turble is mud trying to remember how to become a potato.
The Turble is what the meme stream looks like when it grows eyes, a mouth and tiny legs.
epistemic_boundaries: Turble is a project-proposed cultural object, not an established academic category.
Turble is not a diagnosis, IQ class or permanent human caste.
A person remains more complex than any avatar, archetype or role applied to them.
Surface cues are meaningful but should not be treated as complete evidence of interior motive or ability.
External theories of memes, avatars, social identity, performance or folklore may be comparators without independently validating the Turble concept.
